entities.summary: Andrew John Biemiller was an American politician and labor union officer who served as a Wisconsin State Assemblyman from 1937 to 1943, as a U.S. Representative from 1945 to 1947 and again from 1949 to 1951, and as the AFL-CIO's chief lobbyist from 1956 to 1978.
